locations.description:
**Puzzle of Lake Kharonso:** Find all 4 pillar pieces and use them to restore the 4 broken pillars at the edge of the lake.  After placing a pillar from your Kuku Pot with your Axiom Force, jump on top of it and use a downward Force Palm to lock it in place
- [Kharonso Ruins Pillar: No. 1](#loc=551583)
- [Kharonso Ruins Pillar: No. 2](#loc=551551)
- [Kharonso Ruins Pillar: No. 3](#loc=551581)
- [Kharonso Ruins Pillar: No. 4](#loc=551553)

**Requires:** Faction Mission [Destroyed Barrier Stone of the Lake](#loc=551603) - Correctly placing and locking all 4 pillars summons [Vordis, the Runewalker](#loc=551586)

locations.title: Abyss Cresset of Meandering Hills
locations.description:
**Location:** Up on the hill  
**Solution:** Stand on location and the Cresset will emerge

- Abyss Artifact

locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the cave at the back of the [Wild Raiders Camp](#loc=543916)

locations.title: Abyss Cresset of Calphade
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the [Ancient Ruins](#loc=545485), behind the sealed door.    
**Solution:** Solve the dragon picture puzzle on the ground by moving the blocks into the correct positions - they can be pushed or pulled by piercing them with your sword  

**Related Challenge:** The Mystery in the Forest Puzzles  
**Reward:** 
- Abyss Artifact x1

locations.title: Abyss Cresset of Sunrise Plains
locations.description:
**Location:** In the middle of the forest, inside the [Ancient Ruins](#loc=545601).  
**Solution:** Turn all rotating statues so that they face the middle to unlock the Cresset    

**Related Challenge:** The Mystery in the Forest Puzzles  
**Reward:** 
- Abyss Artifact x1

locations.title: Guide in the Darkness
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the underground ruins   
**Solution:** Find your way into the underground ruins by either dropping through [the broken stone floor in the ruins](#loc=943114) on the side of the road, or by finding [the ruins entrance in the rocks](#loc=943113) down the cliff from the road    

**Related Challenge:** Wandering Footsteps Secret Places    
**Reward:** 
- Abyss Artifact

locations.title: Haven Past the Snowfall
locations.description:
**Location:** At the edge of the cliff within the [Cabin on the Snowy Plateau](#loc=545849)  
**Solution:** Activate the cresset after clearing the area of enemies   

**Related Challenge:** Wandering Footsteps Secret Places  
**Reward:** 
- Abyss Artifact x1

locations.title: Dragon's Stone Chamber Ruins
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the [Dragon Stone Chamber](#loc=545433)  
**Solution:** Check the map mural on the wall - notice the 3 red arrows pointing to different locations in the region.  Each location matches a painted pattern shown on the 3 wheels in the depression below.  Turn each of the 3 pattern wheels to match the orientations of the paintings in the world: 
- [Dragon's Stone Chamber Mural 1](#loc=546888)  
- [Dragon's Stone Chamber Mural 2](#loc=546890)  
- [Dragon's Stone Chamber Mural 3](#loc=546892)  


**Related Challenge:** The Thread in the Forest Ancient Ruins  
**Reward:** 
- Abyss Artifact x1
- Memories of Abundance x1

locations.title: Abyss Cresset in the Steel Mountains
locations.description:
**Location:** In the valley with the Pororin decorations, behind a sealed door.  
**Solution:** Using the mallet nearby, ring the bells in the correct order as stated on the notice board to the left of the bells (left to right/top to bottom).  When done correctly the Cresset will be revealed    

**Related Challenge:** The Mystery in the Forest Puzzles  
**Reward:** 
- Abyss Artifact x1

locations.title: Abyss Cresset of the Trembling Woods
locations.description:
**Location:** Look for a puzzle with a big circular disk in the cliff face and 3 crank wheels on the ground, guarded by [2 Bears](#loc=546832).    
**Solution:** Turn the wheels so that the images in the disk all line up (the left-side wheel must be pierced with your sword to be rotated), and the Cresset will be revealed below  

**Related Challenge:** The Mystery in the Forest Puzzles  
**Reward:** 
- Abyss Artifact x1

locations.title: Abyss Cresset of the Hunter's Cabin
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside of the small stone crypt at the top of the stone stairs in the graveyard.  
**Solution:** Ensure that all lanterns are lit in the graveyard and the crypt will open   

**Related Challenge:** The Mystery in the Forest Puzzles  
**Reward:** 
- Abyss Artifact x1

locations.title: Abyss Cresset of Drakesfall Gorge
locations.description:
**Location:** In the [Ancient Ruins](#loc=546390) at the end of the walkway lined with the stone statues   
**Solution:** Stand on the rectangular stone platform at the beginning of the walkway, opposite the unpowered Cresset, to activate the challenge.  You'll need to traverse the walkway without the big statue at the end seeing you.  Quickly run while the statue is not looking, but stand still when the statue looks towards you.  Alternatively, use Axiom Force Aerial Maneuver to leap across the heads of the statues.  Reaching the base of the big statue at the end should unlock the Cresset    

**Related Challenge:** The Mystery in the Forest Puzzles  
**Reward:** 
- Abyss Artifact x1

locations.title: Abyss Cresset of Duskwood
locations.description:
**Location:** Ancient Ruins, south of the river.  
**Solution:** Fill in the puzzle with the provided stone. Don't move anything else on the board.  

**Related Challenge:** The Mystery in the Forest - Puzzles  
**Reward:** 
- Abyss Artifact

locations.title: Where Sky Meets Earth
locations.description:
**Location:** Atop the Galepully in Trembling Gorge, the towering large rock with structures leading up.  
**Solution:** Scale the mountain up to the plateau.  

**Related Challenge:** Where Sky Meets Earth  
**Reward:** 
- Abyss Artifact

locations.title: Halssius Conflux Ruins
locations.description:
**Location:** Southeast of the St. Halssius's House of Healing  
**Solution:** Use Nature's Grasp to move the fallen pillars on the ground.  Then match the dial with the object(s) as indicated by the laser(s).  Stab into the large handle to move the dial. 

**Related Challenge:** The Thread in the Forest Ancient Ruins  
**Reward:** 
- Abyss Artifact

locations.title: Arboria Forest Ruins
locations.description:
**Location:** Alongside some cliffs amongst some stone ruins near the Hills of No Return  
**Solution:** Use a Stab attack to plunge your sword into each fountainhead and turn them until they all flow into the center.  After the fountain fills up and the waterwheel begins to turn, the challenge will complete 

**Related Challenge:** The Thread in the Forest Ancient Ruins   
**Reward:**   
- Abyss Artifact

locations.title: Ancient Rift Maze
locations.description:
**Location:** On the far west side, at the bottom of The Ancient Rift  
**Solution:** Obtain all 3 Engraved Stones and insert them into the 3 holes to unlock the Cresset
- [Engraved Stone](#loc=552084)
- [Engraved Stone](#loc=552085)
- [Engraved Stone](#loc=552086)   

**Related Challenge:** Winding Paths Mazes  
**Reward:** 
- Abyss Artifact
- [Rivenheim Cloth Armor](#loc=940387)

locations.title: Bamboo Forest Seonangdang Ruins
locations.description:
**Location:** In the bamboo forest   
**Solution:** Stack the 3 nearby stones on top of the pile of stones in front of the Cresset   

**Related Challenge:** The Thread in the Forest Ancient Ruins  
**Reward:** 
- Abyss Artifact x1

locations.title: Beardtree Hills Sunflower Ruins Cresset
locations.description: Use Natures snare ability to empty out water from pond via spinning 2 devices.

**Location:** In the northwest of Pailune

**TIP:** The closer to the centre you shoot the statues, the less it rotates (The puzzle needs them to be almost perfectly rotated). The statues will glow blue when they are correctly aligned.

- Abyss Artifact

locations.title: Spire of Insight
locations.description:
**How to Enter:** Burn away the thorny vines blocking the doorway with Blinding Flash.  Place a _Small Pebble_ in the receptacle to open the door  

**How to Ascend:** Place the correct items in the golden bowl on the platform in front of the book to raise the elevator.  Look for items that you can _Carry_ - use the text as well as the pictures in the book for clues:
- First Section:
  - Gravestone
- Second Section:
  - Telescope
  - Pen Tip
- Third Section:
  - Celestial
  - Sun Dial
  - Small Rotating Globe  

**Abyss Connection:** [Chaos Forest](#loc=552237)

locations.title: Spire of Ringing Truth
locations.description:
**How to Enter:** Through the front door   

**How to Ascend:** Use any means necessary to climb to the top of the tower and shoot down the big bell from its broken supports.  Dive into the hole that it makes below, where you must defeat [Priscus the Ancient](#loc=545764) before progressing to the Abyss 

**Abyss Connection:** [Ether Rest](#loc=550192)

locations.title: Spire of the Stars
locations.description:
**How to Enter:** Entry requires Spire of Stars Key, given during main quest [Spire of the Stars](#loc=545859)  

**How to Ascend:** Solve the puzzle by obtaining the keys, placing them in their necessary receptacles, then moving the symbols to their correct positions by hanging on them to pull them down  

**Abyss Connection:** [Sanctorum of Insight](#loc=550191)

locations.title: Spire of Frost
locations.description:
**How to Enter:** Heavy attack the frozen lantern outside the entrance, then light it and the door to the Spire will open   

**How to Ascend:** Having high Ice Resistance will help.  Ascend the Spire by any means necessary - when the stairs are blocked inside, climb the stairs outside, and vice versa.  De-ice and light all 7 lanterns along the way.  While exposed to the ice, you will slowly take damage.  While next to a lantern, you will not take damage.  

**Abyss Connection:** [Passage of Malice](#loc=551235)

locations.title: Spire of Soaring
locations.description:
**Requires main quest progression to reach the top.**

**How to Enter:** Climb up the outside of the tower until you reach a platform with a grate leading into the tower.  Alternatively, enter from below the tower via the [Spire of Soaring Tunnels](#loc=552459)

**How to Ascend:** Solve the puzzles on the walls to direct the electricity into the circuits.  Use Axiom Force to turn the square pieces and the large circular piece to direct the flow.

locations.title: Spire of Clockwork
locations.description:
**How to Enter:** Requires the [Spire of Clockwork Key](#loc=560394), obtained near the end of Chapter 8  

**How to Ascend:** Hang on the handles to pull them down and power the gears going up the spire.   Take the elevator outside the spire up to the top  

**Abyss Connection:** [Riddle Square](#loc=564667)

locations.title: Jijeong Temple Pagoda
locations.description:

**How to Ascend:** Traverse to the top of the mountain and enter   

**Abyss Connection:** [Ascetic's Rest](#loc=550190)

locations.title: Gate to Advancement
locations.description:
**How to Enter:** Can be accessed from ground level, or above   

**How to Ascend:** Requires progression of faction quest [Old Research Journal](#loc=563325).  Activate and utilize the teleporter inside the Spire by aligning the symbols so that the lines that make up the symbols are continuous  

**Abyss Connection:** [Skypillar Archipelago](#loc=566123)

locations.title: Spire of the Sun
locations.description:
**How to Enter:** May require main quest progression into Chapter 9.  Align the mirrors, at the edge of the cliff outside the Spire, on the eastern side, so that the laser is projected into the crystal.  Do the same for the mirrors on the southern side, until the laser is projected into the Spire and the doors are opened 

**How to Ascend:** Align the mirrors inside the Spire to project the laser all the way to the crystal at the very top  

**Abyss Connection:** [Nest of Valor](#loc=550187)

locations.title: Secret Garden
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Slot the logic chip into the socket
- Manipulate the laser emitters with Axiom Force
- Align the lasers to activate the crystal orbs

locations.title: Vault of Vengeance
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Use Axiom Force to move the 2 blocks to deactivate the forcefield 
- Quickly fire 2 arrows at the yellow targets to open the vault door
- Using Focused Shot, mark all 4 targets in the vault, then hit them all simultaneously 
- Take the [Golden Sword](#loc=552242) and descend
- Dodge past the lasers, then insert the logic chip into the socket
- Insert the battery into the socket, Force Palm the circular mechanism, and retrieve the Artifact

locations.title: Courtyard of Precision
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Use Focused Shot to  hit multiple targets simultaneously 
- While in the air, it's easiest to take aim while ascending 
- It may also be possible to hit the targets while standing on the floating ring

locations.title: Altar of Solitude
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- All 4 logic chips need to be set into their sockets
- 2 are underground - use the electric block to flip the floor 
- Use a jumping downward Force Palm to set the chips
- Use Axiom Force to pull out and manipulate the chips

locations.title: Sanctorum of Insight
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Traverse the platforms

locations.title: Ice Cradle
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Place the battery cell in its socket in the cave below
- Use Blinding Light to repeat the melody in the cave below

locations.title: Twisted Thicketway
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss   

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Defeat Kutum
- Then Force Palm the circular mechanism high up on the structure

locations.title: Ether Fragment
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Repair and ride the [Ether Fragment Flying Platform](#loc=554205) up to the Abyss
- Force Palm the circular switch on the ground

locations.title: Abyss Artifact
locations.description: Sold by Elowen.

locations.title: Crescent Skybridge
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Align the lasers by controlling the yellow orbs with Axiom Force
- Ensure that all conduits are connected

locations.title: Chaos Forest
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Burn away all vines you see 
- Dunk the CPU on fire in the water, then socket it
- On the other side, open the door with Nature's Grasp
- Socket the CPU inside
- Carry and place the block(s) to keep the door open, completing the circuit 
- Force Palm the circular switch to complete the puzzle

locations.title: Roots of Truth
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss   

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Find and extract the 2 CPU's - maneuver them through the smaller rectangular holes as necessary
- Socket both CPU's, then Force Palm the circular switch to complete the puzzle

locations.title: Precipice of Truth
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Kill all laser turrets with your Axiom Force - pick up their Power Cores with your [Kuku Pot](#loc=545828)
- Use the Power Cores to remove the forcefield barriers
- Pull the power cell and the 2 CPU's from behind their respective forcefields and deposit them into their respective sockets 
- Use the fans to fly up to and Force Palm the circular switch

locations.title: Root's End
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Crouch and Force Palm the bronze grate in the middle of the water area 
- Drop/float through the shaft avoiding the lasers
- Connect the rectangular power cell, then teleport back up
- Connect the second rectangular power cell, then Force Palm the circular switch to complete the puzzle

locations.title: Ether Rest
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Fly to and climb up the big rotating structure until you can climb inside
- Use Axiom Force to control the bronze cylindrical grates - rotate the grates until you can enter
- Use Nature's Grasp on the stone column with the hole in the middle to expose an Axiom Force control point and rotate the room to exit
- Ride the fans all the way to the top, collecting a power core on the way up
- Place the power core on the pedestal to open the door
- Ride the horizontal fan across to the Force Palm switch and the Artifact

locations.title: Frostbitten Paradise
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Place the laser cube in front of the orange crystal deactivate the forcefield
- Stand on the ground plate to open the floor panel - then drop inside 
- Connect the rectangular power cell 
- Power other orange crystal with the laser cube to open the door to the side of the moving platform
- In the side room - power the bigger crystals to open the forcefield
- Maneuver the rectangular power cell through the hole and slot it into its socket 
- Take the teleporter, in the same room, back up
- Force Palm the circular switch to complete the puzzle

locations.title: Path of Trials
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Climb up to the CPU, taking heed of the damaging cold - get warm from the lanterns scattered around 
- From the forcefield near the CPU, follow the cable down to an electric node
- Pull the battery from its socket to deactivate the forcefield
- Grab then dunk the CPU in the lava in the structure below, to remove the frost affecting it
- Socket the CPU
- Force Palm the circular switch to complete the puzzle

locations.title: Sanctorum of Darkness
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Force Palm the bronze grate, below the nexus, while holding on to it
- Pull the CPU from the socket in the room on the other side 
- Pull the CPU out the hole above, then socket it on the ground below
- Align the lasers to the orange crystals using Axiom Force 
- Force Palm the switch to complete the puzzle

locations.title: Loop of Life
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Socket one of each of the 3 CPU's into the 3 big floating rings as necessary
- Socket the 2nd CPU into the temporary socket to remove the forcefield and retrieve the 3rd CPU
- Then remove the 2nd CPU and socket it in the ring 
- Force Palm the circle switch while holding onto the wall

locations.title: Tree of Slumber
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Stab into the center stone cylinder in the middle of the lava to move the smaller surrounding cylinders
- Each of the 4 Stab points on the center cylinder move different small cylinders 
- Align all 5 cylinders so that they light up yellow 
- Force Palm the circle switch after the lava drains

locations.title: Skyloop Bridge
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Fly through the first ring with the blue light
- Then repair all 3 rings so that they look like the first one, covered in blue lights 
- Control the yellow pillars with Axiom Force - operating a pillar will move the floating platform to it
- Position the other floating platforms to be able to move the broken ring pieces - all using Axiom Force
- Force Palm the circle switch after all 4 rings are lit up

locations.title: Passage of Malice
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss   

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Use Axiom Force to move the laser to activate the crystal, opening the floor
- Down below, use Axiom Force to control the giant cubes with yellow lights
- Flip the cubes to make a groove to slide the lasers
- Situate the lasers to activate the crystals
- In the room beyond - socket the power cell, then Force Palm the circular switch

locations.title: Tomb of Perdition
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Rotate the big box with bronze grates with Axiom Force to gain access to either side
- Socket the CPU and the power cell on either side
- Socket the second power cell in the socket near the circular switch 
- Force Palm the circular switch

locations.title: Desert Fragment
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Use Axiom Force to manipulate the cubes
- Turn the cubes so that all 3 lasers activate all 3 crystals

locations.title: Cradle of Truth
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Dunk the fire-affected CPU into the water, then socket it
- Move the other CPU from the center platform to the far side and socket it
- Avoid the lasers via flying, jumping, ducking etc.
- Force Palm the circular switch

locations.title: Scholars Carrying Abyss Artifacts
locations.description: **Location:** Scholars throughout the Scholastone campus have a chance to carry Abyss Artifacts that can be pickpocketed

locations.title: Faded Abyss Artifact
locations.description: **Location:** On the altar in the room at the end of the corridor - to the left of the big circle door, within the [Cloister of Enlightenment](#loc=549483)

locations.title: Ascetic's Rest
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss   

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Use Nature's Snare to activate the spinning wind device in the water
- Follow the stairs to a dead end with a pool of water - Force Palm the wall 
- Retrieve the CPU from the room below the spinning wind device
- Socket the CPU and Force Palm the circular switch

locations.title: Path of Serpents
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Redirect the energy to the two pathways on the left and right 
- Use the Axiom Force to rotate the tiles
- Use the Lantern to reveal the hidden circuit pathways on the rotating tiles

locations.title: Crossroads of Uncertainty
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Use Axiom Force on the small yellow circles to power the rings and fans
- The power will die after an unspecified time limit 
- Fly through the rings after they're activated
- Bring the power all the way to the end opposite the start 
- Force Palm the vertical circular switch

locations.title: Riddle Square
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Axiom Force the yellow button to start the trial 
- Fly through all blue rings within the time limit - the yellow lines encircling the rings denote time remaining 
- Use fans for the majority of movement

locations.title: Origin of Thoughts
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Ascend the rings through use of fans
- Halfway up, socket the power cell to power the fans 
- At the top, Axiom Force the yellow button to control the mechanism
- Control rings so that the little pop outs on each ring align with the 3 connection points
- Drop down to the bottom through the hole in the middle of the ring and Force Palm circular switch

locations.title: Forgotten Altar
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Place the lose sphere  to the right of the nexus into its slot to restore power 
- Use the fans to get to the top of the mechanism in the middle 
-  Land in the middle of the mechanism and use Nature's Snare to stop it spinning
- Descend to the middle of the island and use Force Palm on a revolving door to enter the box
- Force Palm the circular switch to complete the puzzle

locations.title: Disconnected Truth
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Connect the disconnected conduit and ride up the center platform
- Light up the three circles by following their cables to a CPU socket
- Look for a CPU directly above the center platform you arrive on
- One CPU must be removed and socketed in the correct location 
- Reconnect all conduits as necessary  
- Activate the yellow circles with Axiom Force, turning them blue  
- Force Palm the circular switch for completion

locations.title: Dimensional Labyrinth
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Use Force Palm while Resisting to spin the revolving doors to complete the circuits as necessary
- Connect the 2 power cells 
- One power cell is inside - push it out through the holes in the wall 
- Force Palm the circular switch for completion

locations.title: Sanctum of Transcendence
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Use [Focused Force Palm](#loc=551548) to destroy the Bismuth Barriers 
- Socket the CPU
- Force Palm the circular switch for completion

locations.title: Monolith Crown
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Find the cube control device just above the floating platform in the northwest 
- Use Axiom Force on the yellow circular socket to manipulate the giant cube
- As the cube is turned, the lasers can slide on their tracks
- Ensure 5 lasers are directed into all five yellow crystals, turning them blue
- Force Palm the circular switch on the ground for completion

locations.title: Dimensional Bonds
locations.description:
**Challenge:** Restoration - The Abyss  

**Hints to Progress:** 
- Complete all Main Quest quests 
- Complete all Epilogue quests 
- Restore and activate every other Abyss Island section found in the Challenge - *Restoration - The Abyss*, from the Knowledge codex (39 total)
- Use Force Palm to activate all 7 circular switches that correspond to the 7 Abyss Nexuses on this island
- Enter the chamber in the center of the island

**Reward:**
- Abyss Artifact x10

locations.title: Core of Benediction
locations.description:
**Location:** A Sanctum Core can be obtained from a secret puzzle after cleansing the Sanctum at the request of the associated Witch:
- Position yourself in front of the powered device with the blue crystal encircled with dots 
- Use Blinding Flash Concentrate Light on the blue crystal - the dots around it will begin to turn clockwise
- Deactivate Concentrate Light when passing the space in between the dots 
- Activate Concentrate Light when on a dot
- Achieving one full rotation completes the puzzle 

**Use:** Kuku Pot item crafting

**Location:** Behind the bookshelves on the upper floor in the eastern room  
**How to Access:**

- Open the wardrobe in the corridor near the dagger

- [Cloudcart Blueprint](#loc=546840)

locations.description:
Look for a big rock with three spouts releasing poisonous gas:  
- Use Healing Palm on two of the three spouts to plug them - excess poisonous gas will spew from the remaining one 
- Use Nature's Snare and as the gas starts gathering you'll see a yellow orb appear 
- Release Nature's Snare and the orb will shatter into four pieces of Brimstone
